intended_object: Transport (`cast`) of `Lp E p μ` to `Lp E p ν` along a proof that `μ = ν`, packaged as a linear isometric equivalence. Inferred from the docstring, which describes it as `cast` along an equality of types, wrapped up so it can be composed with other isometries.
explanation: The body applies `Eq.rec` to the identity `LinearIsometryEquiv.refl` along `h : μ = ν`. Mathematically, when μ = ν the two spaces are the same and this map is the identity. Its only role is to get past dependent-type issues (equal measures do not give definitionally equal types) so that it can be composed with other linear isometries. This is a formalization device for transport along an equality, not a mathematical notion with its own counterpart in the literature. The construction is correct: it is the identity transported along `h`, and its stated generality (any normed field 𝕜, any normed space E, any p ≥ 1) is fully general. I found no matching Mathlib declaration (a grep of Mathlib/MeasureTheory for this pattern returned nothing).
